title: Economy and Creature-Part Commerce
selected_by_owner: Owner Continue following CHU-15 bounded standalone closeout.

in_scope: Review-only typed lot valuation for 87 family policies, 36 signature materials and eight named fixtures; preserve all 4637 catalog dispositions and 2808 numerical preview records.
MIB-13 seven-stage ordered price projection, integer minor units and independent direct purchase/sale payer-budget previews.
Explicit source/destination scope, market, price, route and exchange versions; restriction, license, capacity, currency, tax, tariff, risk, spoilage and net-profit checks; offline export.
boundaries: All new price entries, market/currency fixtures and modifier values are fictional review proposals, not established prices or canonical material identity. Manual subject, custody, modifier, market, scope and permission attestations are not authenticated.

Only independent single-material sample previews; no aggregate harvest stock, automatic rarity/quality/purity/refinement price or merchant acceptance. Merchant specializations are labels; actual supply/demand and market eligibility manually confirmed. Scope kinds represented without implementing native parent inheritance.

Review lots are integer quantities in exact units; modifier stages support explicit basis-point multipliers and nearest rounding, not every MIB-13 modifier operator. Budget covers direct offer or source purchase only; full route liquidity is not validated. Source and destination exchange/cost inputs are fictional snapshots; no inferred connectivity or currency conversion.

No barter settlement, reserve/commit, D17 inventory or balance mutations, route movement, autonomous markets, native integration or external commerce. No actual approval of legal status or material safety.
